documents.title: DOC 78 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 30 - Driving in a dangerous manner
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 30 - Driving in a dangerous manner

details.fact: Car 30 (Bhirombhakdi) drove on the track in the opposite direction while another car was approaching.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Ten-second Stop-and-Go Penalty in accordance with Article 39.3(d) of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations. Since this penalty was assessed post-race, it will be applied as a 30 seconds time penalty. In addition, three (3) penalty points to be added to the Driver’s record. The driver’s total for the 2026 season is 7 penalty points.
details.reason: The Stewards examined CCTV video evidence. They summoned (document 72) and heard the Driver and Team Representative of Car 30 (BHI). As a result of an earlier collision, BHI came to a stop outside the track in the gravel bed at Turn 2. BHI then rejoined the track and continued along the escape road at Turn 1. During the hearing, BHI explained that he waited for most of the field to pass before attempting to rejoin. When he saw the last approaching car and considered that it would safely negotiate Turns 1 and 2, he decided to use the escape road at Turn 1 to return to the race. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined from the CCTV footage that BHI drove fully onto the track in the opposite direction while another car was approaching him in the correct direction of travel. The Stewards considered that BHI created an exceptionally dangerous situation and was wholly responsible for doing so. The Stewards therefore consider this enhanced penalty appropriate for a serious safety violation.

documents.title: DOC 64 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 28 - Unsafe re-join
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 28 - Unsafe re-join

details.fact: Car 28 (Barichello) re-joined the track unsafely Turn 1.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the FIA International Sporting Code
details.decision: Five seconds (5) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F3 Sporting Regulations. As the penalty could not be served in-race, it will be converted to a 3 place grid drop for his next Feature Race. In addition, 1 point to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 1 point.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. They summoned and heard the Drivers and Team Representatives (Documents 53 & 54). Having been forced off track by Car 18 (BAD), Car 28 (BAR) re-joined and had a collision with BAD. Once a car is off-track it is permitted to rejoin; however, this can only be done when it is safe to do so. The obligation to make a safe re-entry is the same whether the driver went off track on their own or if they were forced off. In this case, BAR collided with BAD immediately after re-joining. Having considered the matter extensively, the stewards determine that BAR made an unsafe re-entry. In many cases, a driver has a reasonably large amount of time to determine when, where, and how, they will re-enter. BAR’s window for making the decision to re-join was fairly compressed due to his proximity to Turn 1. On account of that mitigating circumstance, the Stewards elect to impose a reduced penalty for this infraction. The Stewards would like to acknowledge the collision itself for which they find neither driver to be wholly or predominantly at fault. BAR contributed to it by the unsafe re- rejoin for which he has been penalized herein, and BAD bears some fault for having forced BAR off, thus necessitating BAR’s rejoin (see Document 63 for BAD’s penalty). The Stewards believe that the interests of justice are best served by the two decisions dealing with the collective conduct that ultimately led to the collision.

documents.title: DOC 63 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 18 - Forcing Car 28 off track
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 18 - Forcing Car 28 off track

details.fact: Car 18 (Badoer) forced Car 28 (Barrichello) off track approaching Turn 1.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F3 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 2 points.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. They summoned and heard the drivers and team representatives (documents 53 & 54). Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 28 (BAR) attempted to pass Car 18 (BAD) on the right on the approach to Turn 1. BAD reacted to BAR’s move and attempted to seal off the pass by moving towards the right track edge. This crowded BAR beyond the edge of the track. The Stewards determine that BAR made a legitimate move and that BAD’s defensive reaction was made too late. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determine that BAD forced BAR off track. The penalty imposed is the baseline penalty under the Penalty Guidelines and is in accordance with past precedents for this infraction.

Total for the 2026 season = 5 points
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence and summoned and heard the Drivers and Team Representatives of Car 23 (SHI) and Car 31 (XIE) (documents 48 & 49). documents.title: DOC 42 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 5 - Breach of Sporting Regulations Article 24.6
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 5 - Breach of Sporting Regulations Article 24.6

details.fact: One set of dry-weather tyres allocated to Car 5 was not returned within the specified time.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 24.6 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A fine of €2,500 is imposed on the Team. €2,000 of this amount is suspended for the remainder of the 2026 Formula 3 season in accordance with Article 12.4.6 of the FIA International Sporting Code, subject to there being no further breach by the Team of Article 24.6 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations. The remaining €500 shall be paid in accordance with Article 12.8.1 of the FIA International Sporting Code. The fine must be paid within forty-eight hours of notification by bank transfer to the FIA.
details.reason: The Stewards received a report from the FIA Technical Delegate. They summoned the Team Representative (document 41) and heard the Team Representative, two members of the Team’s Operational Personnel, and the FIA Technical Delegate. The Stewards determined that one set of dry-weather tyres allocated to Car 5 was not deposited in the FIA Formula 3 tyre Parc Fermé within the time specified by the FIA Technical Delegate. The tyres concerned remained fitted to Car 5 while the car was under Parc Fermé conditions. However, once the car was released from Parc Fermé, the tyres were outside the designated tyre Parc Fermé for a short period before being deposited there. Article 24.6 requires all allocated dry-weather tyres to be stored in the designated secure area during the times specified by the FIA Technical Delegate. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that, while the Competitor did not gain a sporting advantage, the Competitor was nevertheless in breach of Article 24.6 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations. Taking into account the mitigating circumstances, the Stewards considered a fine to be the appropriate penalty, in line with previous precedent.

documents.title: DOC 39 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 6 - Technical infringement
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 6 - Technical infringement

details.fact: The rear diffuser of Car 6 is lower than the minimum height stipulated in Article 3.4.1a.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 3.4.1a of the FIA Formula 3 Technical Regulations.
details.decision: Disqualification of Car 6 from the Classification of Qualifying Group A. Removal of all times set by car 6 in the Qualifying Session. All cars originally classified behind Car 6 are moved up one place in the Group A Qualifying Classification. Pursuant to Article 34.2 of the FIA F3 Sporting Regulations, permission is given for Car 6 to start the Sprint Race and the Feature Race from the back of the grid after any other penalties have been applied in accordance with Article 34.5 f.
details.reason: The Stewards received the Technical Report (document 35). They summoned the Driver and Team Representative (document 36). The Driver was invited but declined to attend. The Team Representative and the Technical Delegate attended the hearing. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that the height of the diffusor of Car 6 was found to be below the required minimum height stipulated in Article 3.4.1.a of the FIA Formula 3 Technical Regulations. Specifically, even after the tolerance defined in Article 3.4.2 is applied, the rear diffusor is 3mm below the limit on the left-hand side. The measurement was conducted by the Technical Delegate using the standard method. The measurement was taken on multiple occasions for verification, and the FIA platform was also confirmed to be in correct set up. The Team Representative stated, and the Stewards acknowledge, that following the accident that occurred during the Free Practice session, the Team was unable to inspect the car on the official platform as the repairs took a considerable amount of time. Nevertheless, the Stewards determine that it is responsibility of the Competitor to ensure the compliance of the car with the Technical Regulations throughout the Competition. The Stewards therefore issue the disqualification as the standard penalty for a technical infringement.

documents.title: DOC 23 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - Causing a collision with Car 6 in Practice
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - Causing a collision with Car 6 in Practice

details.fact: Car 2 (UGO) collided with Car 6 (DEP) on the front straight.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Drop of five grid positions for the Sprint and Feature Races at this Event in accordance with Article 39.3 (g) of the FIA F3 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 2 penalty points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 4.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. They summoned and heard the Drivers and Team Representatives of Car 2 and Car 6 (documents 15 and 16). Car 6 (DEP) attempted to pass Car 2 (UGO) on the front straight with both cars already to the right of center of the track. UGO immediately moved right to defend, and continued moving toward the track edge. UGO’s defence crowded DEP beyond the edge of the track, at which point a collision occurred between DEP’s left front wing and UGO’s right rear tyre causing a puncture. UGO’s car also left the track before a secondary collision which resulted in DEP hitting the wall. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determine that DEP made a legitimate pass attempt and that UGO’s attempted defensive move was too late. Furthermore, UGO was not entitled to crowd DEP beyond the edge of the track and therefore the Stewards conclude that UGO was wholly responsible for the collision. In determining the penalty, which is greater than past precedents for collisions in Free Practice, the Stewards considered the lateness of the move, the unjustified crowding beyond track limits and the fact that such vigorous defense is unnecessary within the confines of Free Practice.

documents.title: DOC 22 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - Drove erratically in front of Car 5
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - Drove erratically in front of Car 5

details.fact: Driver of Car 2 braked earlier at Turn 7 than could reasonably have been expected
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Reprimand (driving) given to the Driver of Car 2. This is his second Driving Reprimand of the 2026 Season.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. They summoned and heard the Drivers and Team Representatives of Cars 2 and 5 (documents 13 & 14). The Driver of Car 2 (UGO) explained that he had run slightly wide at Turn 6 and, as a consequence, had a lower speed on the approach to Turn 7. He further stated that his braking in front of Car 5 (SLA) was not a brake check. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that, notwithstanding the lower speed of UGO following Turn 6, he braked earlier than could reasonably have been expected in front of SLA. The Stewards considered this to constitute erratic driving and therefore imposed a driving reprimand, the standard penalty during Free Practice.

documents.title: DOC 17 - 2026 Monza Event - INFRINGEMENT - Car 19 - Failure to follow RD instructions - escape road
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 19 - Failure to follow RD instructions - escape road

details.fact: Car 19 (Ho) failed to follow Race Director's instructions with regards to the escape road in Turn 5.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the 2026 FIA International Sporting Code and F3 Monza Competition Notes item 25.2.
details.decision: Warning given to the Driver of Car 19.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. They summoned and heard the driver and team representative (document 12). Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 19 (CHO) left the track at Turn 4 and rejoined without staying to the right of the bollard as required by Item 25.2 of the Event Notes. Given the trajectory and speed at which CHO went off, there was nothing that would have prevented him from safely following the instructions set forth in the Event Notes. The Stewards elect to issue a warning, the standard penalty for such an infringement during Free Practice. Drivers are reminded that anyone going off at Turn 4 will be investigated for compliance with the Event Notes.
